title: Reconcile deliveries with unique pipeline output
method: Synthetic interval has 10,000 unique source events plus 200 duplicate deliveries. Deduplication leaves 10,000;150 fail validation and 9,850 are accepted. Delivery attempts and unique outcomes are different denominators, so chart bars are not additive.
